title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Blueberry Sour Raspberry Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod balances sweet and tangy berry notes in a bold fruit mix. Juicy Blueberry provides a smooth base, while sharp Sour Raspberry adds a tart finish for a lively and moreish vape. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that keeps the pod replenished automatically. Together they deliver up to 20,000 puffs depending on usage, with no messy refills or coil replacements needed. With a 0.8ohm mesh coil built in, the pod delivers consistent vapour and well-defined flavour from first puff to last. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re ready to vape.
